title: Concrete Roller
description: A dark UK bassline roller at 156 BPM: a chopped 808 breakbeat skeleton rides over a gliding sine sub that growls beneath an open mid-range built for a rap flow. The break stutters and reorders under perlin modulation while the filter creeps open across the track, dropping to a dry breakdown before slamming back into a peak.
code:
setcpm(156/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.95),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(220).gain(0.55),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.2,0.45)).pan(perlin.range(0.3,0.7))
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(180,420).slow(7)).gain(0.6),
    s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.25,0.5)).degradeBy(0.15).cut(1),
    s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).pan(0.65)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0)
      .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("[bd hh sd hh bd bd sd hh]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7)
      .speed(perlin.range(0.92,1.12)).chop(2)
      .sometimesBy(perlin.range(0.1,0.4), x => x.rev()),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").add(note(perlin.range(-0.2,0.2)))
      .s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(280,560).slow(5)).gain(0.62),
    note("<g2 eb2 f2 d2>").s("square").lpf(900).gain(0.4).pan(0.4).release(0.2),
    s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.3,0.55)).degradeBy(0.2).cut(1)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*2").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(160,340).slow(6)).gain(0.6).room(0.2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("triangle").lpf(700).gain(0.38).pan(0.5),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.2,0.4)).cut(1)
  )],
  [40, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.05)
      .every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("[bd hh sd hh bd bd sd ht]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.75)
      .speed(perlin.range(0.88,1.18)).chop(perlin.range(2,4))
      .sometimesBy(perlin.range(0.2,0.5), x => x.rev()),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").add(note(perlin.range(-0.25,0.25)))
      .s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(360,720).slow(4)).gain(0.65).shape(0.25),
    note("<g2 eb2 f2 d2>*2").s("square").lpf(perlin.range(700,1400).slow(3)).gain(0.42).pan(0.55).release(0.15),
    s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.35,0.6)).degradeBy(0.18).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.9),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(180,360).slow(6)).gain(0.55),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(perlin.range(0.2,0.4)).cut(1)
  )]
)
